mail_comment_reason_commented: You get this mail because you commented on this recipe.
mail_comment_reason_created: You get this mail because this recipe is yours.
mail_confirm_body: Confirm your email address for your account {username} so Rezepte can reach you there, for example with a link for a new password.
mail_confirm_body_admin: {admin} entered this email address for your account {username}. Confirm it so Rezepte can reach you there, for example with a link for a new password.
mail_confirm_ignore: Don't know Rezepte? Ignore this mail.
mail_confirm_subject: Confirm your email address for Rezepte
mail_confirm_validity: The link is valid for 7 days.
mail_email_changed_body: The email address of your account {username} was changed to {address} on {at}.
mail_email_changed_body_admin: {admin} (admin) changed the email address of your account {username} to {address} on {at}.
mail_email_changed_not_you: Wasn't you? Sign in, set your email address back in your profile and change your password.
mail_email_changed_not_you_admin: Didn't you ask for it? Let {admin} know.
mail_email_changed_removed: The email address of your account {username} was removed on {at}.
mail_email_changed_removed_admin: {admin} (admin) removed the email address of your account {username} on {at}.
mail_email_changed_removed_subject: The email address of your Rezepte account was removed
mail_email_changed_subject: The email address of your Rezepte account was changed
mail_fallback_link: Button not working? Open this link:
mail_hint_body: You sign in to Rezepte with {provider}; you have no password.
mail_hint_footer: Lost access to {provider}? Ask an admin — they can send you a setup link.
mail_identity_linked_body_profile: Signing in with {provider} was added to your account {username} in your profile on {at}.
mail_identity_linked_body_setup_link: Signing in with {provider} was added to your account {username} through a setup link from {admin} (admin) on {at}.
mail_identity_linked_not_you: Wasn't you? Sign in, remove the sign-in method in your profile and change your password. If you can't sign in, tell an admin.
mail_identity_linked_not_you_admin: Wasn't you, or didn't you ask for it? Sign in, remove the sign-in method in your profile, change your password and let {admin} know.
mail_identity_linked_not_you_owner: Wasn't you? Sign in, remove the sign-in method in your profile and change your password. If you can't sign in, whoever has access to the server sets a new password on the command line with rezepte --reset-superadmin-password; then sign in and remove the sign-in method.
mail_identity_linked_subject: A sign-in method was added to your Rezepte account
mail_invite_accepted_body: {name} set up their account with your setup link and signs in as {username}.
mail_invite_accepted_reason: You get this mail because you created the setup link.
mail_invite_body: {inviter} created an account for you on Rezepte, your shared recipe collection. Set a password and start cooking.
mail_invite_existing_body: {inviter} sent you a setup link for your account on Rezepte, your shared recipe collection. Use it to get back into your account.
mail_invite_existing_subject: {inviter} sent you a setup link for Rezepte
mail_invite_ignore: Don't know {inviter}? Just ignore this mail.
mail_invite_validity: The link is valid for 7 days and works once.
mail_password_changed_body_admin: {admin} (admin) set a new password for your account {username} on {at}.
mail_password_changed_body_command_line: The password of your account {username} was reset on the server's command line on {at}.
mail_password_changed_body_profile: The password of your account {username} was changed in your profile on {at}.
mail_password_changed_body_reset_link: The password of your account {username} was changed through a “forgot password” link on {at}.
mail_password_changed_body_setup_link: The password of your account {username} was changed through a setup link from {admin} (admin) on {at}.
mail_password_changed_not_you: Wasn't you? Set a new password right away; that ends every other sign-in.
mail_password_changed_not_you_admin: Wasn't you, or didn't you ask for it? Set a new password yourself and let {admin} know.
mail_password_changed_not_you_owner: Wasn't you? Whoever has access to the server can set a new password on the command line with rezepte --reset-superadmin-password.
mail_password_set_body_admin: {admin} (admin) set a password for your account {username} on {at}.
mail_password_set_body_profile: A password was set for your account {username} in your profile on {at}.
mail_password_set_body_setup_link: A password was set for your account {username} through a setup link from {admin} (admin) on {at}.
mail_password_set_subject: A password was set for your Rezepte account
mail_push_test_body: This is what notifications from Rezepte look like.
mail_recipe_digest_reason: You get this mail at most once a day, when others in your household have added recipes.
mail_reset_body: A new password was requested for your account {username}.
mail_reset_ignore: Wasn't you? Ignore this mail; your password stays as it is.
mail_reset_validity: The link is valid for 1 hour and works once.
mail_security_notice: This is a security notice and can't be unsubscribed.
mail_test_body: This is a test from Rezepte. If you are reading it, mail works.
mail_unsubscribe_kind_comment: No more mails about new comments
mail_unsubscribe_kind_invite_accepted: No more mails about accepted invitations
mail_unsubscribe_kind_recipe: No more mails about new recipes
